propositions: The completion-verification close gate produces bare LLMError with null diagnostic when the agentic verify step enters a tool-call loop and exhausts its step budget, wasting 40-70% of pathological runs.

The existing repetition detector metric is inverted on real traces and cannot distinguish k-cycle loops from healthy breadth, necessitating a windowed distinct-ratio signal with configurable trip threshold.

The provider-broken forced-landing primitive (tool_step_limit empty-filter rewrite) causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 toolConfig errors when tool-use blocks remain in history, and must be replaced with tool-advertisement + synthetic tool results steering.
Budget exhaustion during CompletionAgentStep.run is not caught or made reachable for bounded recovery, because the catch block only handles UnretryableOutputError.

Runaway tool-call cycles must be detected DURING the run, routed to bounded recovery + fresh per-criterion evidence verdict construction instead of provider-outage fallback, and surfaced in gate_error_v1 sidecars with repetition diagnostics.
Gate runs do not durably record request and tool-call usage by default, preventing tuning from data and hindering root-cause analysis of looped vs breadth-exhausted runs.
